title: Themes
subtitle: Track industry trends and topics — not just companies. Matches surface here even when no target company is mentioned in the article.

addTheme.name: Theme name
addTheme.queryTermsPlaceholder: Type a term and press Enter
addTheme.queryTermsHint: Articles matching any of these terms are pulled in — there's no company name anchor, so keep terms specific enough to stay on-topic.
addTheme.sourceAllowlistPlaceholder: Type a domain (e.g. techcrunch.com) and press Enter
addTheme.sourceAllowlistHint: Adds to (never replaces) the workspace-wide trusted-source list for Google News RSS.
addTheme.editionHint: Google News returns different results per country/language. For a topic about the German market, set DE and de. Leave blank to inherit the workspace default.
addTheme.exclusionTermsPlaceholder: e.g. Formel 1 — press Enter after each
addTheme.exclusionTermsHint: Words that mean an article isn't what this topic is about. A topic's search is broad, so this is usually the most effective way to tighten it.
addTheme.sourceDenylistPlaceholder: Type a domain to block and press Enter
addTheme.sourceDenylistHint: Added to the workspace-wide blocked list — it can't remove entries from it.
addTheme.newsSourcesHint: A source must also be enabled under Settings → News sources to be used. Paid sources give topics real article text instead of only headlines, but a topic's search is broad — watch the cost.

activeCeilingReached: The workspace's active theme watch limit has been reached. Pause or delete one first, or ask an admin to raise the limit.
confirmDeleteAdmin: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and all its matches for every user. Continue?
confirmUnfollowOnly: You're the only follower — unfollowing "{{name}}" removes it (and its matches) for everyone. Continue?
confirmUnfollowShared: Unfollow "{{name}}"? Other users tracking it keep seeing it.

matches.title: Matches
matches.subtitle: Articles matched to your theme watches by the same fetch run that pulls signals for your target companies.
matches.noMatchesYet: No matches yet. Add a topic above, then click “Fetch now” on it in the list.

sourceDisabled.title: Google News RSS is disabled
sourceDisabled.bodyAdmin: Topics can only fetch news via Google News RSS. While that source is disabled, your topics will not produce any matches.
sourceDisabled.bodyMember: Topics can only fetch news via Google News RSS. While that source is disabled, your topics will not produce any matches. Please ask an admin to enable it.

run.blockedSourceDisabled: Google News RSS is disabled — topics cannot fetch anything.
run.blockedPaused: This topic is paused. Resume it to fetch news.
run.blockedRunning: A fetch is already running. Wait for it to finish.
run.blockedCooldown: Please wait {{seconds}}s before fetching this topic again.
